notes.title: VR Motion Sickness? We're On It! 👨‍🚀
notes.content:
[p]Hey racers & pilots aka SKYBENDERS!
 We know that VR racing can be intense — and sometimes, it can mess with your head (literally). 😵‍💫[/p][p]That’s why we’re actively working on making [i]Dominate the Skies[/i] [b]more comfortable and nausea-friendly[/b] for everyone. Here’s what we’re exploring:[/p][list][*][p]Optimized cockpit movement & camera stability[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks to FOV & acceleration curves[/p][/*][*][p]Optional comfort settings (like vignetting, snap turns, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Better HOTAS/controller feedback syncing with visuals[/p][/*][/list][p]We want every session to feel [i]thrilling[/i], not [i]queasy[/i]. If you’ve experienced any motion discomfort, we hear you — and we’re tweaking things so that [i]Dominate the Skies[/i] can be enjoyed longer and smoother by all.[/p][p]— [i]Team DTS[/i][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update: Smoother Skies Ahead!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hey Skybenders![/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback — and we hear you loud and clear! Our team is currently hard at work fine-tuning the [b]onboarding experience[/b] for [i]Dominate the Skies[/i]. [/p][p]We want every new pilot to feel confident, capable, and combat-ready from the moment they strap in. That means:[/p][p]✅ Streamlined tutorials.
✅ Clearer HUD!
✅ More intuitive mission progression.
✅ A smoother learning curve for both flight and combat mechanics.[/p][p]Whether you’re a rookie getting into your first anti-gravity dogfight or a seasoned ace returning for another round, the upcoming updates will help you take off faster and fly smarter.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more details soon — and as always, thanks for being part of this growing community.[/p][p]Now go out there and [b]Dominate the Skies[/b]!
 — Team DTS[/p]

notes.title: HOTAS-Inspired Controls in the Works!
notes.content:
[p]We’ve officially implemented [b]HOTAS-inspired controls[/b] in our test build — and this is just the beginning. 🕹️
We’re working hard to bring an intuitive, throttle-and-stick experience that feels natural, especially for new pilots taking their first flight in [i]Dominate the Skies[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]This system is still [b]a work in progress,[/b] and your feedback will help us fine-tune it to perfection. We’re committed to making sure flying not only feels great but gives you the authentic control you’ve been waiting for.[/p][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]If you haven’t already — hit that 💚 Wishlist button![/b]
It really helps us, and you’ll be the first to know when we drop major updates, fixes, and the full launch.[/p]
